inputs.text: South African actress Terry Pheto is facing more controversy following new details presented in Parliament on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The revelations, which link her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission, came up during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition.
